```{r}
# Front vs Back coverage (this is by turn_id midpoint)
tx_span <- d |>
  group_by(transcript_id) |>
  summarize(
    min_turn = min(turn_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_turn = max(turn_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    midpoint = (min_turn + max_turn) / 2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
d_with_mid <- d |>
  left_join(tx_span, by = "transcript_id") |>
  mutate(half = if_else(turn_id <= midpoint, "front", "back"))

front_back_counts <- d_with_mid |>
  count(transcript_id, half) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = half, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

# ratio
front_back_summary <- front_back_counts |>
  mutate(back_front_ratio = if_else(front > 0, back / front, NA_real_))

head(front_back_summary)
```

```{r}
# Distribution: back/front ratio
ggplot(front_back_summary, aes(x = back_front_ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "lightpink", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Front vs Back Coverage by Transcript",
    x = "Back/Front Ratio",
    y = "Number of Transcripts"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# smaller numbers = fewer ratings in back half compared to front half of transcript

```

```{r}
#Topic quality 
topic_qc <- d |>
  group_by(transcript_id) |>
  summarize(
    n_annotations    = n(),
    n_unique_topics  = n_distinct(new_topic),
    n_same_topic     = sum(new_topic == previous_topic, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

head(topic_qc)
summary(topic_qc$n_unique_topics)
summary(topic_qc$n_same_topic)

# 3a18db1d-a49e-48ee-b598-545465442c74
# high n_annotations but low n_unique_topics
```

```{r}
# Distributions: topics

ggplot(topic_qc, aes(x = n_unique_topics)) +

  labs(title = "Unique Topics per Transcript",
       x = "Count of distinct new_topic", y = "Number of Transcripts") +

# diagnostic: previous_topic == new_topic counts
ggplot(topic_qc, aes(x = n_same_topic)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 55, fill = "tomato", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "rows with previous_topic == new_topic",
       x = "No change rows per transcript", y = "number of Transcripts") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
#Final QC, flags

# thresholds
    
fail_threshold  <- 2    
at_risk_limit   <- 10
qc <- d %>%
  group_by(transcript_id) %>%
  mutate(
    min_turn = min(turn_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_turn = max(turn_id, na.rm = TRUE),
    midpoint = (min_turn + max_turn) / 2,
    half     = if_else(turn_id <= midpoint, "front", "back")
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    n_annotations   = n(),
    front = sum(half == "front", na.rm = TRUE),
    back = sum(half == "back",  na.rm = TRUE),

    back_front_ratio= if_else(front > 0, back / front, NA_real_),
    n_unique_topics = n_distinct(new_topic),
    n_same_topic    = sum(new_topic == previous_topic, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
  flag_low_ann      = n_annotations <= at_risk_limit,  
  flag_very_low     = n_annotations <= fail_threshold,  
  flag_topic_repeat = n_same_topic > 0,

    qc_fail = n_annotations <= fail_threshold,                     
  at_risk = (n_annotations <= at_risk_limit) | (n_same_topic > 0) 
)

names(qc)
qc

readr::write_csv(qc, "qc_summary_by_transcript.csv")

to_recollect <- qc %>%
  filter(qc_fail | at_risk) %>%
  arrange(desc(qc_fail), desc(at_risk), n_annotations)

# HELEN DEFINED TO RECOLLECT
# 44 transcripts only have 1 annotation provided
#205 transcripts have less than 10 annotations provided (includes 44 with only 1 annotation)
#1 transcript has 30+ repeating annotations (3a18db1d-a49e-48ee-b598-545465442c74)
#107 transcripts have a repeating topic

helen_recollect <- qc |>
  filter(n_annotations < 10 | flag_topic_repeat == TRUE | transcript_id == "3a18db1d-a49e-48ee-b598-545465442c74")

write.csv(helen_recollect, "/Users/helenschmidt/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-helenschmidt129@gmail.com/My Drive/SANLab/Experiments/Conversation-Structure/data/processed/full-sample/qc_failed_transcripts.csv")


cat("Transcripts total:", nrow(qc), "\n")
cat("QC fail (n_annotations <= 2):", sum(qc$qc_fail), "\n")
cat("At risk (n_annotations <= 10 OR topic repeat):", sum(qc$at_risk), "\n")

```

```{r qc_failed_ids, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(jsonlite)

# IDs of transcripts that failed QC
failed_ids <- qc %>%
  filter(qc_fail) %>%
  transmute(transcript_id = as.character(transcript_id)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(transcript_id)

cat("QC-failed transcripts:", nrow(failed_ids), "\n")
head(failed_ids)

# Exports
readr::write_csv(failed_ids, "qc_failed_transcripts.csv")
jsonlite::write_json(
  list(transcript_ids = failed_ids$transcript_id),
  "qc_failed_transcripts.json",
  pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE
)
writeLines(failed_ids$transcript_id, "qc_failed_transcripts.txt")
```
